craft_notes: Sthāyin: apart-making emission. Rows: qualifier, parting, pair-dependence. Rejected: rite/colours invention — killed: not in L3; sung from true lines. Read aloud: unfolding.

lines: Now the qualifier part called slight to be known, and the deed —
till she, kalā, parts it from herself,
even this, the enjoyed-common inwoven with pleasure, pain, delusion —
the mere common, fellow of that sameness —
so the enjoyer-and-enjoyed pair, together, on kalā-truth depends.
l4.sanskrit_cite: idānīṃ viśeṣaṇabhāgo yaḥ kiṃcid ity ukto jñeyaḥ kāryaś ca taṃ yāvat sā kalā svātmanaḥ pṛthak kurute tāvat eṣa eva sukhaduḥkhamohātmakabhogyaviśeṣānusyūtasya sāmānyamātrasya tadguṇasāmyāparanāmnaḥ prakṛtitattvasya sargaḥ iti bhoktṛbhogyayugalasya samam eva kalātattvāyattā sṛṣṭiḥ
